reuse.why: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but encodes its own version of the daily-vs-move weekend rule (moveWeekend) that the tree keeps inside shared getNextDate rather than sharing it.

duplication.why: The RSchedule construction, weekend mapping and try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper repeat getUpcomingDates, and the weekend decision for daily schedules now lives here and in getNextDate.

placement.why: The handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way; the weekend rule itself would fit better in #shared/schedules.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear and commented, but a second home for the daily/weekend rule and a duplicate import of #shared/months (namespace plus named) leave things to reconcile later.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange reshapes getUpcomingDates' occurrence/weekend pipeline and getNextDate's daily-schedule weekend branch into a moveWeekend flag instead of sharing them.
